quote: But if you keep the hammer and use it to drive nails, who can doubt its worth?
content: The hammer in the koan is personal: "When you concentrate on a real-world question, the worth or worthlessness of your understanding will soon become apparent." The community built public ways to test it. Annual calibration reports that score each forecast, and forecasting platforms heavily used by this readership, put the techniques on public record where anyone can check the results. The closest controlled test of the curriculum is the Good Judgment Project. A short training module in probabilistic reasoning, covering reference classes, granular updating and bias awareness, improved forecasting accuracy on real geopolitical questions (Mellers et al. 2014). A controlled evaluation of the sequence itself has not been done, and that should be conceded. The toolkit it teaches has been tested, and it drove nails.
